scope: Read-only static trace of local-release copy-active-sources and related methodology path/export helpers; no writer execution, imports, tests, or edits to production code.

source_pins.role: Production release phases, fixed product root, source selection, and copy target construction.
Active selection obtains the parsed Scope Unit declaration structure and pins it.
Authority and Delivery paths are separately derived; Authority includes Scope Unit ID and Delivery omits it.
Shared path resolver returns source authority, product root, source-copy delivery, and applicable delivery paths.
Compiler uses declaration-based source/output paths for the applicable-methodology projection; source layer roots are Authority paths.
Frozen methodology export preserves each selected source_path as its candidate destination; it does not derive Delivery layer directory names.
Pinned D667 naming rule and the three current exact Authority-versus-Delivery directory names.
Post-move destination state and observed source/reference inventory.

trace.finding: The release source allowlist is exactly CORE_META_MODEL, INSTALLED_EXTENSIONS, and PROJECT_CONFIGURATION. _read_structure reads the matching active_selection scope rows but retains only each row's authority_path; delivery_path is discarded.

The shared selection helper has both paths available. The parser independently derives Authority components with Scope Unit ID and Delivery components without ID, and exposes both in each structure row.

The copy-active-sources phase writes under the hard-coded product path and sets each destination directory to product/SUPERLAYER_1_METHODOLOGY_SOURCES/source.name. Since source came from authority_path, source.name is the ID-prefixed Authority name. The files are copied relative to that Authority source.
A shared resolver computes declared product and source-copy Delivery roots, but the local_release phase does not call it. The compile phase separately hard-codes its applicable output relative path.

The compiler correctly reads declared Delivery path for its applicable output, while source layer roots remain Authority paths. The frozen export writes pinned source_path values unchanged. Neither is the release copy's directory-name correction.

verdict.other_branch: Applicable-methodology compile uses declared METHODOLOGY_SOURCES delivery output, but local_release overrides the output with a fixed relative path; frozen methodology export preserves source_path and is not this copy phase.
verdict.next_action: Update the local_release copy phase to retain each selected Scope Unit row's derived delivery_path (or resolve the existing MethodologyLayout) and construct children relative to the declared METHODOLOGY_SOURCES delivery root. Keep reading source bytes from authority_path. Also resolve product/copy/applicable roots through the declared layout rather than parallel hard-coded roots, then have the CA #3-owned runtime gate verify a future copy produces the three D667 directory names without changing Authority sources.

limitations: Static source inspection only; the writer was not executed or imported and no tests were run.
No claim is made about runtime activation or effects beyond the directly read path construction.
This audit does not alter Authority, Delivery files, Workflow/Workbench carriers, or Git state.
